card.name: Verb slot before a clause-ending gap
card.fires_on: The word "thoroughly" in "infusion lines are thoroughly flushed" in ceftriaxone label text. It also fires on a verb or auxiliary such as take, are, is or can that ends a clause with its object left out.

modes.label: Lines thoroughly flushed
modes.description: The adverb "thoroughly" before "flushed" in ceftriaxone and calcium infusion-line wording.
modes.example: ceftriaxone and Calcium Gluconate Injection may be administered sequentially, provided the infusion lines are<< thoroughly>> flushed between infusions with a compatible fluid

modes.label: Clause-final verb
modes.description: A verb or auxiliary after a subject, where the clause ends or its object has been moved earlier in the sentence.
modes.example: I have no idea what species it<< is>>, though.
